stem.text: Two light sources are used to produce an interference pattern.
Interference fringes appear when the two sources emit waves that are coherent.
What is meant by coherent waves?

A.text: The two waves are emitted with the same frequency.

B.text: The two waves are emitted with constant phase difference.

C.text: The two waves are emitted with the same intensity.

D.text: The two waves are emitted with zero phase difference.
